title: Computer vision tool for detection, mapping, and fault classification of photovoltaics modules in aerial IR videos
mechanism: Detects, tracks and georeferences PV modules in drone IR video and extracts per-module image stacks for classification.
evidence: R: ResNet-50 > 90 % test accuracy on 10 anomaly classes; follow-up SfM version mapped 99.3 % of 35,084 modules and extracted > 2.2 M module images (per web summary of arXiv 2204.02733).
adaptation: Module-ID map and per-module crops for WattCycle flights; lets a later EL session be matched module by module for a pre-registered EL queue.
min_experiment: Run on a public sample video, then on the first WattCycle flight; report share of modules mapped. Tooling, no kill line.
prior_overlap: Desk study idea W02 (module ID map) planned, not run.
